newsitem.title: USA: CNN says interested in CBS's Dan Rather.
newsitem.headline: CNN says interested in CBS's Dan Rather.

text.p: Cable News Network, which last month failed to woo Tom Brokaw from NBC News, said Monday it has set its sights on Dan Rather, the anchorman at CBS News.
"If Dan Rather were to become available, CNN would be interested," a CNN spokesman said. Rather is in the middle of a contract with CBS that expires in 1999.
CNN, a unit of Time Warner Inc., has been seeking a big-name anchor to help boost its sagging ratings.

The 24-hour cable news network had sought to lure Brokaw with a long-term, multi-million dollar contract, but Brokaw instead chose to sign a new five-year deal with NBC, a unit of General Electric Co.
Rather was on vacation and unavailable for comment. CBS declined to comment, except to say, "We're very fortunate that Dan's in the middle of a multi-year contract."
CBS is owned by Westinghouse Electric Corp.
